corrections.reason: The printed glyph in the image is ሣ (ንጉሥ ሣ) in ሣራን.
The printed glyph has the 7th-order loop (ሞ) for the biblical place name ደወለ ሞዓብ.
The printed text shows 4th-order ፋ in the proper name ውርፋን (Orpah).
The image prints ምራቶቿ (without an extra ዋ) and 6th-order እ in the traditional Amharic Andemta idiom እላትና ትተክልናለች ('she will eat and plant/conceive for us').
The image clearly shows 4th-order ፋ in ውርፋ፡ followed by 1st-order ተ in ከሞተ (matching ከሞተ እቴቴ in line 6).
The initial character in the image is 1st-order አ in አገርሽ አገሬ ('your country is my country', Ruth 1:16).

corrections.old_text: ል ፤ እሆ በከመ ቃልከ ። እንደ ቃ
corrections.corrected_text: ል ፤ ኦሆ በከመ ቃልከ ። እንደ ቃ
corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez particle of assent ኦሆ ('so be it / amen') is printed with 7th-order ኦ.
The printed glyph is 1st-order አ in the Amharic noun አራሪ ('harvester/reaper' leaving gleanings ለማራሪ 'for the gleaner').
